specs.Item Highlight: Bluetooth Enabled, Alarm & Stopwatch, LED Backlight, Day & Date Display, Rubber Strap

description: Stay on top of your game with this rugged Sport Digital Watch, designed for those who lead an active lifestyle. Featuring a bold, all-black square case with a high-contrast LCD display, this watch delivers all the essential information at a glance — including the time, date, and day of the week. The built-in Bluetooth connectivity allows you to pair the watch with your device, while the alarm (ALM) and stopwatch (SPL) functions make it a reliable companion for workouts and outdoor adventures. The backlight feature ensures excellent visibility even in low-light conditions. With a water resistance rating of WR30M, this watch can handle splashes and brief water exposure with ease. The durable resin strap offers a comfortable, secure fit on the wrist, making it suitable for all-day wear. Intuitive side buttons — Light, Mode, Start, and Reset — give you quick access to all functions. Whether you are hitting the gym, going for a run, or simply want a dependable everyday timepiece, this sport watch is built to keep up with your pace.
